hero.title: Volume *and* rigour. Both.
hero.line: NBFCs win on speed and reach — but thin files and high volume make disciplined underwriting hard. Newron automates the mechanical work so you can grow the book without growing the risk.

faq.a: Yes. Statement analysis runs in under a minute and the suite is built for high-throughput origination, with human review reserved for exceptions and deviations.

faq.q: We lend on thin files — does that work?
faq.a: Newron is tuned for Indian thin-file lending, combining banking, GST and bureau signals to build a defensible picture where traditional documents are sparse.

faq.q: Does it support co-lending audit needs?
faq.a: Every decision carries a sourced, exportable audit trail suitable for co-lending partners and lenders' due diligence.

faq.q: How quickly can we onboard a new product?
faq.a: New products configure in days because the underlying models are pre-trained on Indian commercial and consumer credit.

cta.title: Scale the book, not the *risk*.
